description: Update the hand-written install commands on the AGRO site to the canonical harness ids.

userStories.title: Update the hand-written install commands to the canonical names
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want each install command to use the canonical harness id so that the command matches the AGRO CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/pages/index.tsx` shows `agro harness install claude` in the quick-start code block.
`git grep -nE 'harness install (claude-code|grok-build|antigravity-cli|muse-code)' -- src docs blog` exits 1.
The `AGENTS` ids in `src/pages/index.tsx` stay unchanged, because each id is the slug of a synced doc page.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill: the landing page quick-start block shows `agro harness install claude`.

userStories.title: Record the manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want an annotated screenshot of the landing page so that the PR `## Manual review` section shows the change.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/short-harness-names/evidence/manual-review.md` embeds an annotated screenshot of the landing page quick-start block from `pnpm serve`.
The advisor stops `pnpm serve` after the capture.
